timberfall.screen.title: Timberfall Settings
timberfall.option.enabled.tooltip: Master switch. When off, logs break one at a time like vanilla.
timberfall.option.mode.tooltip:
Instant: the whole tree disappears the moment you break a log.
Block by Block: the tree breaks one block at a time with a short delay, starting at the log you chopped.
timberfall.option.delay.tooltip:
Block by Block mode only. Time between two blocks breaking. 20 ticks = 1 second.
Leaves break in quick batches so the canopy does not take forever.
timberfall.option.auto_pickup.tooltip:
Put everything the tree drops straight into your inventory.
If your inventory is full, the rest drops on the ground.
timberfall.option.use_durability.tooltip:
On: every log costs your axe 1 durability, like normal mining.
Off: felling a tree is free.
timberfall.option.protect_axe.tooltip:
Only matters when durability is used.
If your axe could not survive the whole tree, only the one log you hit breaks, so the axe never snaps halfway.
You get a message on the action bar when this happens.
timberfall.option.replant.tooltip:
Plants a sapling where the trunk stood.
My Saplings: takes one from the tree's own drops or your inventory.
Free: always plants one, no sapling needed.
timberfall.option.break_leaves.tooltip: Also remove the leaves the tree was holding up. Player placed leaves are never touched.
timberfall.option.require_axe.tooltip: Only fell trees while holding an axe.
timberfall.option.require_leaves.tooltip:
Only fell a log cluster if natural leaves are attached to it.
This keeps log cabins and builds safe.
timberfall.option.sneak_rule.tooltip:
Chop One: hold sneak to break a single log normally.
Fell: only fell trees while sneaking.
Ignore: sneaking changes nothing.
timberfall.option.max_blocks.tooltip:
Log clusters bigger than this are not treated as one tree and break normally (you get a message when that happens).
Trees that touch each other count as one cluster, so dense jungles and dark forests need a higher limit.
